newsitem.title: USA: AmeriResource unit in $1.85 mln settlement.
newsitem.headline: AmeriResource unit in $1.85 mln settlement.

text.p: AmeriResource Technologies Inc said Tuesday its Tomahawk Construction unit will receive a payment of $1.85 million to settle a claim with MK-Ferguson of Oak Ridge/U.S. Department of Energy.
The company said it will receive the payment before July 10, subject to final approval by U.S. Bankruptcy Court. The company emerged from reorganization in the past year.
Tomahawk also said it has negotiated a reduction of about $1 million in accounts payable, which it expects will have positive results on its balance sheet.
AmeriResource provides construction management services for the economic development of the native American community.
